7. Detergent / Washing Problems — Detailed
Troubleshooting Manual
This document contains 8 separate troubleshooting topics. Each topic starts on a new page and is written as a
sequential procedure. User-level checks are separated from service-level diagnosis.
Model basis: Samsung's WA5471ABP/XAA support page lists the model-specific User Manual (version 4, modified May 3, 2016). The
technical information for the WA5471 series documents troubleshooting areas including water valves, inlet screens, hoses, water level
sensing, drain/spin, motor, PCB connections, and related service diagnosis. turn0search13I
Samsung WA5471ABP/XAA — Detergent / Washing Problems
Page 2

7.1. Detergent remains in dispenser
What this means: Detergent remains in dispenser is treated as the observed symptom or fault condition.
Follow the steps in order and stop when the cause is identified.
Step-by-step procedure

Step 1. Stop the cycle and identify whether the problem is caused by detergent quantity, detergent type,
dispenser buildup, or washing conditions.

Step 2. Check the detergent package instructions and use only the detergent type and quantity appropriate for the
washer and load.

Step 3. Inspect the dispenser. Remove visible residue and clean the accessible dispenser components according
to the manual.

Step 4. If excessive suds are present, allow the washer to complete its appropriate suds-management/rinse
behavior rather than adding more detergent.

Step 5. For poor cleaning, check load size, cycle selection, water supply, and whether heavily soiled items need
pretreatment.

Step 6. Run a suitable rinse or cleaning cycle after correcting the detergent issue and observe whether residue or
suds remain.

Step 7. If the problem continues despite correct detergent use and a clean dispenser, investigate water supply,
cycle selection, and service-level causes.
When to escalate: If the problem remains after the safe external checks, or if the washer shows repeated electrical,
sensor, control, motor, valve, pump, or lock faults, stop user troubleshooting and arrange qualified service.
